text: GENERAL & ADMIN INFO The Company expects to pays $200 a month in salaries The Company pays the sales representatives only commission and that is based off of 1% of sales The Company anticipates supply expense will be $20, $25, and $20 respectively for January, February and March The Company purchased equipment for $1,000 on January 1, 2024 and will depreciate over 100 months using straight line depreciation.
